sections.title: Health and wellbeing: meaning and form
body: Goal: Describe symptoms and duration, understand care instructions and ask an appropriate follow-up question.
Core vocabulary: ett symtom, yr, återhämta sig. Key phrases: Jag har haft feber i tre dagar. · Jag har ont i halsen och känner mig yr. · När bör jag kontakta vården igen?

Use Jag har ont i … for pain and Jag har haft … sedan/i … for duration continuing until now: sedan i måndags, i tre dagar. Advice often uses bör, kan or an imperative. In urgent symptoms, follow the service's instructions rather than relying on language practice.
Say the examples aloud, notice the pattern, and then change one detail rather than memorising a fixed script.

For listening and reading, answer from a specific word or phrase. For speaking and writing, make the recipient, purpose and next action clear.
Attempt the task before using the model. Improve one high-impact feature, then perform it again with the transfer condition.

assignment.title: Four-skill task and transfer
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: First listen without a transcript. Answer: What should the patient keep nearby? Replay once and identify the exact words that prove the answer.

READ: Read for purpose and evidence. Answer: When should the reader contact healthcare? Mark the shortest phrase that supports your choice.

SPEAK: Call a clinic about a non-emergency problem. Describe two symptoms, say when they began and ask what you should do next. Make a first attempt, check clarity and repeat once.

WRITE: Write a concise symptom update for a digital appointment: symptoms, duration, effect on daily life and one question. Check reader, purpose, required details and next action.

TRANSFER: One symptom has improved but a new symptom began this morning; update the report accurately.

BETWEEN LESSON · Optional, 5 minutes: retrieve the three key phrases without looking, then use one in a new sentence.
